verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents monitors that automatically check connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP against control requirements. A Monitors page shows each monitor's status, including violations found, and the integrations page claims continuous monitoring with alerts on compliance violations. However, the documented refresh cadence is "up to daily or ad-hoc", which does not establish that failing controls surface within hours, so coverage of the story is partial. Missing for 10: documented hourly or near-real-time test cadence, detail on how violation alerts are delivered and how fast, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, automated tests run continuously against my connected systems — failing controls surface within hours, not at the annual audit

citations.quote: Monitors automatically check your connected systems (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) for compliance with the control's requirements.
Monitors and integrations will be refreshing data up to daily or ad-hoc
Review their current status (healthy, violations found, connection errors)
Thoropass collects compliance-relevant data automatically, keeping you audit-ready and alerting you to compliance violations
